title: Graph-Validated Retrieval for Occupation-Skill Mapping in a HybridRAG Prototype
authors: Sungbae Jo, Jotham M. Hernandez, Yunseon Kim, Dongkyun Kim
venue: International Journal of Internet, Broadcasting and Communication, 18(5), 352–366
journal: International Journal of Internet, Broadcasting and Communication
description: Adds a graph validation step to vector retrieval, using a knowledge graph built from the Singapore Qualification Framework. Across 87,664 query-target pairs, Precision@1 rose from 0.739 to 0.928 and MRR from 0.804 to 0.928, at a cost of about 6 ms in average latency. The validator returned no candidate for 7.2% of queries.
